say:1:1141109001:1.text: There's no set technique for hunting. It's all about instinct.
say:1:1141109001:1.source_cn: 狩猎根本没什么技巧而言，对于猎手来说，只是驱动本能行事。
say:1:1141109001:1.male: There's no set technique for hunting. It's all about instinct.
say:1:1141109001:1.female: There's no set technique for hunting. It's all about instinct.

choice_prompt:2:1141109001.text: There's no set technique for hunting. It's all about instinct.
choice_prompt:2:1141109001.source_cn: 狩猎根本没什么技巧而言，对于猎手来说，只是驱动本能行事。
choice_prompt:2:1141109001.male: There's no set technique for hunting. It's all about instinct.
choice_prompt:2:1141109001.female: There's no set technique for hunting. It's all about instinct.

say:3:1141109002:1.text: By that, I mean keeping your cool even when you're facing starvation.
say:3:1141109002:1.source_cn: 在无尽的饥饿中保持冷静。
say:3:1141109002:1.male: By that, I mean keeping your cool even when you're facing starvation.
say:3:1141109002:1.female: By that, I mean keeping your cool even when you're facing starvation.

say:4:1141109004:1.text: Sometimes, when prey's right in front of me, I feel like I'm the one falling.
say:4:1141109004:1.source_cn: 猎物倒在我面前时候，我偶尔能看到倒下的自己。
say:4:1141109004:1.male: Sometimes, when prey's right in front of me, I feel like I'm the one falling.
say:4:1141109004:1.female: Sometimes, when prey's right in front of me, I feel like I'm the one falling.

say:5:1141109005:1.text: Only those who don't understand nature's power find hunting thrilling. They'll pay for their arrogance someday.
say:5:1141109005:1.source_cn: 只有低估自然的人才会觉得狩猎有趣，而低估自然的人，总有...
say:5:1141109005:1.male: Only those who don't understand nature's power find hunting thrilling. They'll pay for their arrogance someday.
say:5:1141109005:1.female: Only those who don't understand nature's power find hunting thrilling. They'll pay for their arrogance someday.

say:8:1141109007:1.text: How lucky! A life of abundance keeps you away from slaughter.
say:8:1141109007:1.source_cn: 多么幸运，富足的生活让你远离了屠戮。
say:8:1141109007:1.male: How lucky! A life of abundance keeps you away from slaughter.
say:8:1141109007:1.female: How lucky! A life of abundance keeps you away from slaughter.

say:9:1141109010:1.text: No matter what you hunt for, for whatever reason...
say:9:1141109010:1.source_cn: 无论是出于什么目的，也无论猎取了什么——
say:9:1141109010:1.male: No matter what you hunt for, for whatever reason...
say:9:1141109010:1.female: No matter what you hunt for, for whatever reason...

say:10:1141109011:1.text: Never waste any part of your kill. This is the least you can do to show your respect for nature.
say:10:1141109011:1.source_cn: 不要浪费掉猎物身体的每个部分，不然就是对自然的不敬。
say:10:1141109011:1.male: Never waste any part of your kill. This is the least you can do to show your respect for nature.
say:10:1141109011:1.female: Never waste any part of your kill. This is the least you can do to show your respect for nature.

say:12:1141109008:1.text: I advise you to stay away if you wish to hunt just for fun.
say:12:1141109008:1.source_cn: 如果是出于兴趣，劝你远离。
say:12:1141109008:1.male: I advise you to stay away if you wish to hunt just for fun.
say:12:1141109008:1.female: I advise you to stay away if you wish to hunt just for fun.

say:13:1141109009:1.text: It shouldn't be hard for you to understand, then.
say:13:1141109009:1.source_cn: 那我说的，你应该不难理解。
say:13:1141109009:1.male: It shouldn't be hard for you to understand, then.
say:13:1141109009:1.female: It shouldn't be hard for you to understand, then.

choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 从没享受过狩猎过程吗
